units.text: Aspose.Cells FOSS for Rust is a free, open-source, pure-Rust library for creating, loading, editing, and saving Excel .xlsx (Office Open XML / SpreadsheetML) workbooks. It exposes an API modeled after Aspose.Cells, so the familiar Workbook / Worksheet / Cells object model is available to Rust programs with no proprietary runtime, no Microsoft Office installation, and no external Aspose dependency. The library implements the OOXML packaging format — ZIP container, relationships, shared strings, styles, worksheet XML, and charts — from scratch on top of general-purpose crates.

It reads and writes .xlsx files from a path, a stream, or in-memory bytes using Workbook.load_xlsx, Workbook.load_xlsx_from_bytes, or Workbook.load_xlsx_from_stream, and saves them using Workbook.save_xlsx, Workbook.save_xlsx_to_bytes, or Workbook.save_xlsx_to_stream. It provides methods to inspect and repair damaged packages via LoadOptions.try_repair_package and LoadOptions.try_repair_xml, and exposes structured diagnostics through Workbook.get_load_diagnostics.

It reads typed cell values—string, double, boolean, and date-time—via Cell.get_string_value, Cell.get_double_value, Cell.get_bool_value, and Cell.get_date_time_value, and writes values and formulas with cached results using CellMut.put_value_string, CellMut.put_value_i32, CellMut.put_value_bool, CellMut.put_value_date_time, and CellMut.put_formula_with_cached_value.

It applies styling through CellStyle.font, CellStyle.fill, CellStyle.borders, CellStyle.number_format, CellStyle.horizontal_alignment, CellStyle.vertical_alignment, and CellStyle.wrap_text, with Font.set_color, Font.set_is_bold, Font.set_is_italic, and Font.set_underline for font-level control.

It manages worksheets by adding them with WorksheetsMut.add, renaming with Worksheet.set_name, controlling visibility via Worksheet.set_visibility_type, freezing and unfreezing panes with Worksheet.freeze_panes and Worksheet.unfreeze_panes, and sizing rows and columns using Worksheet.set_row_height and Worksheet.set_column_width, while protecting and unprotecting sheets via Worksheet.protect and Worksheet.unprotect.

It enforces data validation rules with ValidationCollection.add, Validation.set_type, and Validation.set_operator, and applies conditional formatting through ConditionalFormattingCollection.add, FormatCondition.set_type, and FormatCondition.set_style for cell-value, expression, color-scale, data-bar, and icon-set rules.

It creates charts with ChartCollection.add and Chart.chart_type, embeds pictures via PictureCollection.add, inserts drawing shapes using ShapeCollection.add, and builds sparkline groups with SparklineGroupCollection.add and SparklineGroup.sparkline_type.

It builds structured tables with ListObjectCollection.add and ListObject.show_totals, applies auto-filters via Worksheet.auto_filter and AutoFilter.set_range, and retrieves sort state details through AutoFilter.get_sort_state and AutoFilterSortState.get_sort_conditions.

It reads core document properties like DocumentProperties.get_author and ExtendedDocumentProperties.get_company, sets properties such as DocumentProperties.set_title, and manages workbook protection using Workbook.protection, WorkbookProtection.get_is_protected, Workbook.protect, and Workbook.unprotect.

The primary entry point is Workbook, which owns a Worksheets / WorksheetsMut collection of Worksheet objects. Each Worksheet exposes its cells through get_cells() / get_cells_mut(), returning a Cells / CellsMut accessor used for individual Cell / CellMut access, row/column collections, and merged ranges.

The Cell and CellMut types represent a single worksheet cell and expose value, formula, and style operations, with CellValue and CellValueType enumerations defining the kinds of values a cell can hold.
The Cells and CellsMut types provide access to worksheet cells, rows, columns, and merged ranges, with CellArea identifying ranges and CellsMut.merge supporting range merging operations.
The CellStyle type represents a mutable cell style facade that can be applied to one or more cells, with Font, Fill, Borders, and Border types defining font, fill pattern, and border properties.
The Chart type represents a chart embedded in a worksheet, with ChartCollection managing multiple charts and ChartType specifying the chart type.

The AutoFilter type represents auto filter functionality, with AutoFilter.get_range, AutoFilter.set_range, and AutoFilter.get_sort_state methods supporting range configuration and sort state retrieval.
The ListObject type represents an Excel table (structured reference / ListObject), with ListObjectCollection managing multiple tables and ListObject.show_totals controlling totals row visibility.
The Picture type represents a picture (image) anchored to a worksheet, with PictureCollection managing multiple pictures.
The Shape type represents a drawing object (auto shape) anchored to a worksheet, with ShapeCollection managing multiple shapes.
The SparklineGroup type represents a sparkline group containing sparkline items that share type and settings, with SparklineGroupCollection managing multiple sparkline groups.
The Hyperlink type represents a hyperlink, with HyperlinkCollection managing hyperlinks defined for a worksheet.
The DefinedName type represents a defined name, with DefinedNameCollection managing defined names at workbook or worksheet scope.
The Comment type represents a worksheet comment (legacy note) anchored to a single cell, with CommentCollection managing comments on a worksheet.
Aspose.Cells FOSS for Rust reads and writes .xlsx (OOXML/SpreadsheetML) workbooks and provides a Rust API to manipulate worksheets, cells, formulas, and formatting.

It supports only the .xlsx format for input and output, with no support for legacy .xls (BIFF), ODS, or CSV, and the public API surface is broad but not a complete match for Aspose.Cells — some features are still partial, and the crate is early-stage and evolving.
A workbook must always keep at least one worksheet: WorksheetsMut.remove_at returns a CellsError::Unsupported error when asked to remove the last remaining worksheet.
No automated test suite ships yet (cargo test --all-targets currently reports 0 tests).
The crate is not yet published to crates.io.
Installation requires a git-dependency workaround.
The package uses Rust edition 2021 and version 26.7.0.
CellObjectValue represents the type of value stored in a cell.
CellValue represents the actual data stored in a cell, such as a string, number, boolean, or decimal.
CellsError indicates an error condition encountered while processing cell data.
DateSystem specifies the date system used for date calculations in a workbook.
DiagnosticSeverity indicates the severity level of a diagnostic issue found during workbook loading.
HorizontalAlignment specifies the horizontal alignment of text within a cell.
VerticalAlignment specifies the vertical alignment of text within a cell.
